name: Hiroki NTR
source:
This is a NTR visual Novel about a guy name Hiroki. An average high school student... nerd ... otaku.. However, he doesn't care what other people call him, because he has a girlfriend named Yuumi...

Yuumi is rich, smart, beautiful and good at anything she does. How did they become a couple? They've known each other since kindergarten.

Will they live happily ever after? No! The title says it all!

[Edited from F95Zone]
translation:
这是一部关于一个名叫弘树的男人的NTR视觉小说。一个普通的高中生……书呆子……宅男……不过，他不在乎别人怎么称呼他，因为他有一个女朋友，名叫悠美……

Yuumi富有、聪明、美丽并且擅长她所做的任何事情。他们是怎么成为情侣的？他们从幼儿园就认识了。

他们会幸福地生活在一起吗？不！标题说明了一切！

[编辑自F95Zone]
